name: Petrox Resources Corp.
summary: Petrox Resources Corp., a junior oil and gas company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and production of petroleum and natural gas resources in Canada. It owns a production property located in Fletwode, Saskatchewan. The company was formerly known as Petrox Capital Corporation and changed its name to Petrox Resources Corp. in August 2012. Petrox Resources Corp. was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Calgary, Canada.
